_comment: Known serious/critical axe violations (WCAG 2.x A/AA), keyed by route then by axe rule id. The suite fails on any serious/critical violation NOT listed here, and also fails when a listed rule no longer occurs on that route (so this list can only shrink). Fix the app, then delete the entry. Keys with [dark] are audited with the dark theme.
